title: Woods's partner frozen at the wheel
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I even tried pulling his hand off that steering wheel.

plain: Mario Woods, a former US Air Force man who served at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, describes a strange night there in 1977 on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels. He says his partner, Michael Johnson, froze in place at the steering wheel of their vehicle, so stiff that Woods even tried and failed to pull his hand off it. He tells it as part of an encounter he believes involved something not human taking control of them.
